title: BA1/882/2003 of HITENDRA PRAKASH PAL Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISIDCTION
Dated: Nainital the 9th day of October 2003
Bail Application No. 882 of 2003
Order on the bail application of accused.
CRIMINAL SIDE
Hitendra Prakash Pal S/o Om Prakash Pal
R/o Girital Colony,
P.S. Kashipur
District: Udham Singh Nagar -----------Applicant
Versus
State of Uttaranchal. --------Opposite party
_________________________________________________________________________

Arising out of case crime no. 844 of 2003
U/S 304/201 I.P.C.
P.S. Kashipur
District- Udham Singh Nagar
By the Court
Hon'ble M.M. Ghildiyal, J.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A.
 No specific role has been assigned to the applicant. Considering the
facts and circumstances of the case it is a fit case for bail.
 Let the applicant Hitendra Prakash be released on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two sureties each in the like
amount to the satisfaction of C.J.M. Udham Singh Nagar.
09.10.2003: (M.M. Ghildiyal, J.)
MPS
